facts.text: roboverse is a set of environments that use PyBullet to simulate robotic manipulation tasks
The documented use is env = roboverse.make('Widow250DoubleDrawerOpenNeutral-v0', gui=True), then env.reset() and env.step(env.action_space.sample())
The requirements pin gym 0.12.1 (the legacy Gym API) and pybullet 2.7.9
roboverse.make is gym.make and the environments are registered with gym.register
Widow250Grasp-v0 is registered with entry_point roboverse.envs.widow250:Widow250Env and control_mode discrete_gripper
The action vector is eight-dimensional: ACTION_DIM = 8
The action space is a gym.spaces.Box with one bound per action dimension, built from act_bound 1 (so every entry is in -1..1)
step reads action[:3] as an end-effector position action, action[3:6] as an orientation action, action[6] as the gripper action and action[7] as the neutral action
xyz_action_scale defaults to 0.2 and abc_action_scale to 20.0
The target end-effector position is the current position plus xyz_action_scale times the xyz action, and the target orientation adds abc_action_scale times the abc action
ee_pos_low defaults to (0.4, -0.2, -0.34) and ee_pos_high to (0.8, 0.4, -0.1)
The target end-effector position is clipped between ee_pos_low and ee_pos_high before the action is applied
num_sim_steps defaults to 10, num_sim_steps_reset to 50 and num_sim_steps_discrete_action to 75
The default grasp thresholds are object height -0.25 and object-gripper distance 0.1
check_grasp succeeds only when the object height is above the height threshold and the distance from the end effector to the object is below the distance threshold

get_observation returns a dictionary with the keys object_position, object_orientation, state and image; state concatenates the end-effector position (3), quaternion (4), gripper joints (2) and the gripper-open flag (1)
The image observation is the rendered image flattened and divided by 255 into float32 values
observation_img_dim defaults to 48
The observation_space declares an image whose length is observation_img_dim squared times 3 and a 10-entry state bounded by +/-100
reset() resets the simulation, loads the meshes, resets the robot joints and returns get_observation()
step returns (observation, reward, done, info) and done is always False, so the environment never terminates on its own
The reward for reward_type grasping is the target object's grasp-success flag as a float
The physics step is 1/240 s with 150 solver iterations and gravity -10
connect_headless calls p.connect(p.DIRECT) when gui is false
Widow250Env connects to PyBullet in its constructor through bullet.connect_headless(self.gui)
The WidowX 250 URDF wx250s.urdf is loaded at base position [0.6, 0, -0.4]

determinism.notes: the fake draws object positions with random.Random(seed) and applies every action deterministically, so a seed and an action sequence repeat a trajectory; upstream reset() takes no seed and draws object positions from numpy's global generator (roboverse/bullet/object_utils.py:114-120), so the same seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory unless numpy is seeded globally as well

gaps: the fake is a kinematic point model: the end-effector position changes by xyz_action_scale times the action and is clipped to the upstream ee_pos bounds; there are no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, gravity or inverse kinematics, and the abc action only accumulates a tracked orientation
no image rendering: the real observation image is a 48x48x3 float32 vector of 6912 values (roboverse/envs/widow250.py:339-341); the fake returns a 12-value stand-in (test data)
no PyBullet: the upstream environment connects to p.DIRECT (roboverse/bullet/core.py:5-11); the fake never imports or runs it and was not compared with it

no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0; one environment step advances 10 PyBullet steps of 1/240 s (41.6667 ms) by default, but a discrete gripper toggle advances 75 steps (312.5 ms) (roboverse/envs/widow250.py:46-48), so the declared fixed timestep covers the common 10-step case and the fake applies one action per tick without sub-stepping
snapshot and restore are not offered: Widow250Env exposes no get_state or set_state
the fake models only the target object and has no tray, table, link collision or camera; the upstream step is legacy Gym with done always False and no truncation, which the fake mirrors

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
